native.fixture: Deterministic editor + real Electron + stdio MCP
checks: real main-frame navigation events share one pending identity read
native island starts compact; all dispatched calls expand and mirror without throttling; bridge restrictions and rounded hit geometry
stdio MCP read scans; idle and completed calls retain the current canvas without extra model reads or inferred progress
complete artboards fit independently of editor pan/zoom; structure trees, floating tools and editor-only overlays never enter the image or change source UI
overview opens complete; single-page calls fit their full viewport; completion and metadata retain focus; new page targets switch focus and whole-canvas reads restore overview
multi-artboard layout/spacing is preserved; editor loading clears stale pixels and never collapses the card
collapse/reopen reuses cached pixels and preserves scope/context without a renderer; async content refreshes and save metadata does not
scroll-content editing keeps isolated expanded content without tools, preserves live DOM/model/context and refreshes on exit
task stages, explicit plan, blocker persistence, actual write/result/error and continuously updating hidden mirror

account overview uses API totals without a canvas; creation refreshes totals; logout clears old identities; verified replacement restores account data; localized labels and sign-in action fit; MCP subject, queue, persistent error and recovery remain visible
native Preview real DOM snapshot/click, actual route, current view capture, shared theme/language, stale labeling and recovery
monotonic ten-minute expiry; native hover/leave grace overrides running calls and idle leases; completion stays collapsed and the next call reopens

right-click actions distinguish showing main from exiting island, remove floating icons, retain Preview; real fullscreen transitions and rapid mode changes serialize correctly; local preference persists
shared update manager across standard/island modes; background ring, fixed-size confirmation/progress, Later and no main-window reveal; install drains MCP, closes Preview and saves before restart
signed-out capsule keeps the Plasmic brand and localized login link; native hover stays compact; login invokes sign-in while the main window stays hidden
closing the main window during fullscreen transition releases the mode queue

closeMode.environment: official 0.5.30 renderer with current Desktop sources/tests in a temporary isolated App copy

limits: Native editor and network are deterministic fixtures.
No real-project CPU/RAM or startup speed comparison.
No user App installation or deployment.
